purpose: Validate the first bounded evidence-backed caller integration: explicit scope plus semantic plan selects the exact Safari canvas caller contract, then the normal runTask path remains semantic-first and reaches visual fallback only after structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
requiredClaims: If Safari is already running, execution is blocked before immutable evidence is created.
The real Safari application requests the loopback test-owned canvas surface physically observed in P6B.
The semantic planner output contains only ACTIVATE_APP and OPEN and contains no scope, postcondition, provider identity or coordinates.
The caller explicitly supplies scope p6b.safari.canvas.v1 outside the planner.
The product plan-aware caller helper matches scope plus application plus OPEN plus exact target and materializes exactly one execution contract.
A wrong scope selects no contract and therefore authorizes no fallback.
The materialized contract contains no concrete provider object or action coordinates.
The normal product runTask path executes semantic OPEN first and reaches visual fallback only after structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
Perception-provider selection remains lazy, Computer Use-owned and selects the local macOS Vision text-region provider only after the eligible gap.
Real Computer Control delivery returns CLICK_POSTED with semanticConsequenceVerified=false.
CLICK_POSTED is not task success; VERIFIED_SUCCESS requires the independent post-action observation basis.
No screenshot bytes, OCR payload strings or coordinates are logged in session evidence.
Pointer, Safari, loopback server, runtime/cache and temporary resources are cleaned up and product trees remain clean.
nonClaims: P6C does not enable generic Safari or arbitrary web visual fallback.
P6C does not make the registry implicit for CLI/default runTask callers.
P6C does not put scope, target coordinates, provider selection or postconditions in planner output.
P6C does not broaden exact matching, gestures, displays or provider capabilities.
P6C does not alter Computer Control runtime contracts.
P6C does not claim a general production Safari skill; it validates the bounded caller-integration mechanism on the P6B evidence-backed surface.

evidencePolicy.safariUserState: Preflight blocks before session creation if Safari is running; the physical test repeats the guard for races.
evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s01 unchanged, diagnose the exact boundary and create s02 only after a forward-only change justified by evidence.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned canvas content is used. Screenshot bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates remain ephemeral and out of session evidence.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P6D first real product skill/caller that supplies an explicit bounded scope, without weakening P5/P6 contracts
